verdict.rationale: LocalAI's core model is a single binary/Docker image exposing an OpenAI-compatible API on port 8080 (docs-31, docs-32), and CI-tested CPU-only paths (docs-27) imply straightforward server/CI deployment. However, the docs emphasize a built-in web UI for chat/config (docs-20) and never explicitly document a headless/no-GUI mode, disabling the UI, or CI-specific guidance. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI deployment docs, confirmation the web UI can be disabled or is optional, and independent evidence of server-only CI usage.
